description: Baseline capture fixtures for Phase 0 evaluation. Each entry models a real capture from the first 38 stored memories audit (2026-09-30). Labels: 'keep' = durable fact/decision worth storing, 'drop' = noise.

captures.raw_content: Bash: git commit -m 'Add pgvector HNSW index to memories table' -> success

captures.raw_content: We decided to use pgvector with HNSW indexes because cosine distance queries on 1536-d vectors need sub-100ms latency. The m=16 and ef_construction=64 parameters are a good starting point.
captures.label: keep
